responsibility: Declares the parsing interface and parser-state objects for Rust builtin asm!-family macro expansion. This header defines InlineAsmContext and LlvmAsmContext, the InlineAsmParseError result protocol, and the helper entry points that parse format strings, registers, operands, clobbers, labels, options, and validation for asm/global_asm and LLVM-style inline assembly invocations, producing AST::InlineAsm-related fragments from MacroInvocLexer token streams for the expansion subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This header is the interface half of the rust-macro-builtins-asm pair: it declares InlineAsmContext, LlvmAsmContext, parse/validate entry points, and helper APIs for asm/global_asm and LLVM asm parsing, while the same-stem .cc file provides their definitions.
